questions.text: Arun's total drawings during the year were Rs. 90,000. Interest on drawings is to be charged @ 5% (the deed does NOT say per annum). Interest on Arun's drawings is:
questions.explanation: rate is not p.a. -> flat % on total drawings IOD = 90000 x 5/100 = Rs. 4,500  Correct option B. Distractors: A = applied a 6-month time factor though the rate is not p.a.; C = treated it as drawn at the beginning of every month; D = treated it as drawn at the end of every month.
